title: Tiny meteorites are everywhere. Here’s how to find them.
summary: Verge Science's pilot of its Trial & Error series follows amateur scientist Jon Larsen on a hunt for micrometeorites. It shows how tiny space rocks can be found on rooftops and confirmed under a microscope.
why: HN recommends it as an accessible demonstration of how anyone can collect micrometeorites at home.

quote.text: Here's a good video running through one way to do this at home
